metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene lunch bags, boxes, and totes for your team. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for logo imprinting. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Poly propylene lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer a cost-effective, lightweight alternative to canvas or nylon. The non-woven material resists moisture and tearing, making it ideal for corporate picnic giveaways, safety incentive programs, or daily cafeteria use. With a smooth surface, these bags accept screen-printed or heat-transfer logos cleanly, ensuring your brand stands out at events or in break rooms. Choose poly propylene for a budget-friendly promotional item that still delivers durability and a professional look.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene lunch bags, boxes, and totes with screen-printed logos, stacked for bulk order display.
